v.vls.command.description: Path or command name for the V language server binary. If empty, the extension looks for `vls` in PATH.

v.vls.args.description: Arguments to pass to the V language server.

v.executablePath.description: Path or command name of the V compiler used by VLS and V build, run, and test tasks. Supports absolute paths, ~, ${env:NAME}, and ${workspaceFolder}.

v.tools.updateChannel.description: Which upstream to compare installed tools against. `master` follows the latest commit, `release` follows the latest released tag; VLS always follows its own master.

v.tools.checkForUpdates.description: Check for V and VLS updates when the extension activates. Checks run at most once a day and require a trusted workspace.

v.vls.defines.description: Compile-time defines VLS checks with, e.g. ["-d", "flag"] or ["-dflag"]. VLS reads vls.json too; the editor setting wins.

v.vls.coverageDirectory.description: Directory a `v -coverage` run recorded into. VLS reads it to offer Generate test actions for untested functions.

v.vls.inlayHints.variableTypes.description: Show inlay type hints from VLS.

v.vls.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show inlay parameter-name hints from VLS.

v.vls.coverage.enabled.description: Collect test coverage and highlight covered and uncovered executable lines after V test tasks.

v.vls.mcp.enable.description: Offer VLS as an MCP server to agents, exposing compile checks, hover, definitions, references, rename, symbols and completion. Only offered when the configured VLS answers an MCP handshake; VLS has no `--mcp` mode in the versions verified so far, so this stays off there rather than registering a server that exits on first use.

v.errorLens.enabled.description: Show inline diagnostic messages and line highlighting for V files.

v.errorLens.messageMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of an inline diagnostic message.

v.errorLens.delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing decorations.

v.pathIntellisense.enabled.description: Enable filename completion in string literals.

v.pathIntellisense.showHiddenFiles.description: Show hidden files in path completion.

v.pathIntellisense.autoSlashAfterDirecto.description: Append a slash after completing a directory.

v.pathIntellisense.autoTriggerNextSugges.description: Automatically trigger the next suggestion after completing a directory.

v.pathIntellisense.absolutePathToWorkspa.description: Resolve absolute paths against the workspace root.

v.importCost.enabled.description: Show inline source size for V imports.

v.importCost.includeTests.description: Include _test.v files when measuring an imported module.

v.importCost.cacheTtlMs.description: Cache TTL in milliseconds for import size measurements.

v.templates.jsxAutoDetect.description: Auto-detect JSX/TSX inside template script blocks for React support. Language stays HTML; detection only guides hover/completion helpers.

v.templates.enableEmmet.description: Recommend Emmet for template files. Writes emmet.includeLanguages for html only, never overrides your setting.

v.templates.enableTailwind.description: Recommend Tailwind CSS IntelliSense for template files via tailwindCSS.includeLanguages.

vls.command.description: Deprecated alias of `v.vls.command`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

vls.args.description: Deprecated alias of `v.vls.args`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

vls.vCommand.description: Deprecated alias of `v.executablePath`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

vls.inlayHints.enabled.description: Deprecated alias of `v.vls.inlayHints.enabled`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

vls.diagnostics.enabled.description: Deprecated alias of `v.vls.diagnostics`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

vls.coverage.enabled.description: Deprecated alias of `v.vls.coverage.enabled`. Kept so settings from the former VLS extension keep working.

v.mcp.enable.description: Offer the V compiler to agents as an MCP server, giving them the compiler's own view of the project: declarations, references, diagnostics and standard library documentation. Needs a V that supports `v mcp`.

v.mcp.readOnly.description: Start the V MCP server with --read-only, which registers no tool that writes a file. Turning this off also exposes v_rename_symbol, v_format and v_edit_replace. Note that v_edit_replace has no preview: it writes as soon as the range matches the text the agent passed back, so passing that text is what approves the edit.

v.mcp.root.description: Directory the V MCP server resolves relative paths against. Empty means each workspace folder. Set it when the V project root differs from the folder you opened.

v.debug.usePrettyPrinters.description: Load the V GDB pretty printers at session start.

enumDescriptions: Run the workspace with v run .

Build an optimized executable with v -prod .

Report whether the formatter would change the workspace with v fmt -verify.

program.description: The V source file to debug.

stopAtEntry.description: Break at the start of the program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the program. Defaults to the workspace folder.

miDebuggerPath.description: Path or command name of the MI debugger. Supports absolute paths, ~, ${env:NAME}, and ${workspaceFolder}. Empty means the MIMode default on PATH.

MIMode.description: The MI debugger to run the session under. The V pretty printers only load under gdb.

text.description: An MI command to run after the debugger starts, e.g. GDB skip rules for generated frames.

setupCommands.description: Extra MI setup commands, run after the pretty-printer commands under gdb.

environment.description: Environment variables for the debugged program.

envFile.description: Path to a KEY=VALUE environment file for the debugged program. Entries overwrite environment.

externalConsole.description: Run the program in an external console instead of the integrated terminal.

sourceFileMap.description: Map build paths to local source paths, e.g. for remote targets.

miDebuggerServerAddress.description: Address of a remote MI debugger server, e.g. localhost:2345.

pipeTransport.description: Reach a remote debugger through a pipe program such as ssh.

program.description: Path to the running binary, for symbols. Nothing is compiled on attach.

processId.description: Process ID to attach to. ${command:pickProcess} shows the adapter's process picker.

coreFile.description: Path to a core dump; gdb DAP forwards this to the inferior.

cwd.description: Working directory for expression evaluation. Defaults to the workspace folder.

miDebuggerPath.description: Path or command name of the MI debugger. Supports absolute paths, ~, ${env:NAME}, and ${workspaceFolder}. Empty means the MIMode default on PATH.

MIMode.description: The MI debugger to run the session under. The V pretty printers only load under gdb.

setupCommands.description: Extra MI setup commands, run after the pretty-printer commands under gdb.

sourceFileMap.description: Map build paths to local source paths, e.g. for remote targets.

miDebuggerServerAddress.description: Address of a remote MI debugger server, e.g. localhost:2345.

pipeTransport.description: Reach a remote debugger through a pipe program such as ssh.
